name: App icon call to action
technique: The official app icon (dark or light) lands on an elastic spring with a soft glow, the line sharpens in, an orange button pops and is pressed once at the end — the final ask, held long enough to act on.
notes: Only say 'App Store / Google Play' once the app is actually published there. 'Falas' (free) must be true for the user side.
